title: Final 12 V amplifier headroom requires physical proof
component_interface: 12 V amplifier headroom with selected speakers
description: The product explicitly forbids final supply freeze until required electrical/acoustic performance is measured in the real crib. A 24 V change is conditional on that evidence.

evidence.note: 12 V versus possible 24 V is a measured decision.

closure_criterion: With the chosen speaker and actual crib, record target attenuation and required Vrms/Irms across the test band, impedance, THD, excursion, simultaneous stereo loading and ANC reserve at worst-case supply; approve 12 V or formally reopen architecture before R13 PASS.
